name: Unta-Guta Bounty Hunter (CR 1/2)
body:
UNTA-GUTA BOUNTY HUNTER
CR 1/2

This humanoid has pebbly, blue-green reptilian skin, large black eyes, a tapir-like snout, and two short antennae. Its long, sucker-like fingers wrap around the handle of a wickedly sharp sword.

XP 200
Unta-guta slayer 1
N Medium humanoid (unta-guta)
Init +3; Senses blindsense 30 ft., low-light vision; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 13, flat-footed 13 (+3 Dex, +3 armor)
hp 12 (1d10+1+1)
Fort +4, Ref +6, Will +1

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee kukri +1 (1d4+2 S, 18-20/×2), kukri +1 (1d4+1 S, 18-20/x2) or kukri +3 (1d4+2 S, 18-20/×2)
Ranged longbow +4 (1d8/x3 P, range incr. 100 ft.)
Special Attacks studied target (+1)

STATISTICS

Str 15, Dex 16, Con 13, Int 12, Wis 12, Cha 6
Base Atk +1; CMB +3; CMD 16
Feats Two-Weapon Fighting
Skills Acrobatics +6, Bluff +3, Knowledge (local) +5, Perception +5, Sense Motive +5, Stealth +8, Survival +7 (+8 to find or follow tracks); Racial Modifiers +2 Stealth, +2 Survival
Languages Common, Unta-Guta
SQ bladetrained, track +1
Gear NPC gear (studded leather armor, 2 kukri, longbow with 20 arrows, other gear)

ABOUT

For unta-gutas, all of life revolves around “The Hunt.” Unsurprisingly, many of them make excellent bounty hunters, excelling at tracking down everyone from escaped criminals to long-lost relatives. While many bounties on criminals are payable “dead or alive,” many unta-gutas definitely prefer the former option. Ironically, if a hunt is too easy, an unta-guta may decline the job—or may give the hunted a head start in order to make the contest more of a challenge.

Galactic Legions, Vol. 2: In the Shadow of the Empire. 2026, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author. Bryan Mangum.
